in_marathi.name: Ilisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Illusion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ilisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ilisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Ilani', which refers to the goddess of illusion and magic in Hindu mythology. This name is believed to be bestowed upon children born under the influence of the goddess, representing a life filled with creativity, mystery, and enchantment.
